dmm-2022-tiebreaker-01.prompt:
The sequence $\{x_n\}$ is defined by
$$x_{n+1}=\begin{cases}2x_n-1,&\text{if }\frac12\le x_n<1,\\2x_n,&\text{if }0\le x_n<\frac12,\end{cases}$$
where $0\le x_0<1$ and $x_7=x_0$. Find the number of sequences satisfying these conditions.

dmm-2022-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Let $M=\{1,\dots,2022\}$. For any nonempty set $X\subseteq M$, let $a_X$ be the sum of the maximum and the minimum number of $X$. Find the average value of $a_X$ across all nonempty subsets $X$ of $M$.
